msg: So, the Gnomes are split into two groups, based on their "hat" size. You have big hats and little hats. Ignore the colours, they don't seem to be that important. One group will provide more points than the other until suddenly that group offers no points, at this point you want to start picking the other group.What I noticed is that if the little hats offer more points, it will likely stay this way until you reach a double - i.e., there are 2 big or 2 little hats on the screen. When this happens, it will switch to the other group being worth more points until you see another double.This can happen in quick succession though. So if you are currently picking little hats and then you get a double big followed by another double big, chances are itll still be the little hats worth more points.That's what I noticed, at least!
